The institutional investor held 875,322 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $112.17 million, down from 891,673 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Klingenstein Fields & Co Llc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $328.86B market cap company.
